title: Canonical memoization timing-authority reconciliation
problem: The F-AHL42 admission workflow used the historical F-AHL28B single absolute warm-bind timing gate. F-AHL28B itself classified that single-run gate as narrowly failed and explicitly deferred timing authority to a paired reconciliation. F-AHL28C subsequently passed the unchanged 75 percent reduction requirement using nine paired batches.
bounded_code_repair: Combine exact same-key authority comparison with hydraulic-profile homogeneity verification in one fast-path scan. On any mismatch, independently verify full profile homogeneity before cache acquisition.
semantic_gates: changed step duration still rebinds analytical fallback
same-key reuse does not touch shared-cache accounting
change in any active node invalidates the fast path
